listing.name: WH Rogue Trader Portrait Pack V1.0
listing.summary: This mod adds over 40 portraits from the game Warhammer 40k: Rogue Trader, playable characters, companions and some of the major characters, in addition to that there are also 3 portraits from the concept art of the game 40k Darktide.
listing.aiSummary: Adds over 40 character portraits from Warhammer 40k: Rogue Trader and Darktide concept art for player use and faction encounters.

description: Adds over 40 portraits from Warhammer 40k: Rogue Trader, including playable characters, companions, and major figures, plus three from Darktide concept art. All portraits are available for player use, while human portraits appear in some vanilla factions.
